set-payload.doc:name: WhatsApp Template Input

on-error-propagate.type: HTTP:BAD_REQUEST, HTTP:UNAUTHORIZED, HTTP:FORBIDDEN, HTTP:TOO_MANY_REQUESTS, HTTP:INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, HTTP:SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, HTTP:TIMEOUT, HTTP:CONNECTIVITY

raise-error.description: Falha ao enviar a mensagem pelo WhatsApp.

db:select.doc:name: Load Notification
db:select.db:sql: SELECT n.id, n.status, n.template_name, n.template_language, n.recipient_phone, e.sender_name, e.sender_email, e.subject, e.received_at, c.urgency_level, c.classification_reason FROM notifications n JOIN emails e ON e.id = n.email_id LEFT JOIN email_classifications c ON c.email_id = e.id AND c.classifier_version = 'heuristic-v1' WHERE n.id = CAST(:notificationId AS uuid)

db:update.doc:name: Mark Sent
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE notifications SET status = 'SENT', provider_message_id = :providerId, sent_at = now(), updated_at = now(), last_error_code = NULL WHERE id = CAST(:notificationId AS uuid)

db:insert.doc:name: Record Attempt
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO notification_attempts (notification_id, attempt_number, status, error_code) VALUES (CAST(:notificationId AS uuid), CAST(:attemptNumber AS integer), 'SUCCEEDED', NULL)

db:insert.doc:name: Record Failed Attempt
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO notification_attempts (notification_id, attempt_number, status, error_code) VALUES (CAST(:notificationId AS uuid), CAST(:attemptNumber AS integer), 'FAILED', :errorCode)

db:update.doc:name: Mark Notification Failed
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE notifications SET status = CASE WHEN CAST(:attempts AS integer) >= CAST(:maxAttempts AS integer) THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'PENDING' END, last_error_code = :errorCode, updated_at = now() WHERE id = CAST(:notificationId AS uuid)

raise-error.description: Envio da notificação falhou; será tentado novamente conforme a política.

db:select.doc:name: List Notifications
db:select.db:sql: SELECT n.id, n.email_id, n.channel, n.status, n.template_name, n.provider_message_id, n.last_error_code, to_char(n.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS created_at, to_char(n.sent_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS sent_at FROM notifications n WHERE (CAST(:status AS text) IS NULL OR n.status = CAST(:status AS text)) AND (CAST(:cursor AS timestamptz) IS NULL OR n.created_at < CAST(:cursor AS timestamptz)) ORDER BY n.created_at DESC LIMIT CAST(:limit AS integer)

db:select.doc:name: Get Notification
db:select.db:sql: SELECT id, email_id, channel, status, template_name, provider_message_id, last_error_code, to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS created_at, to_char(sent_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS sent_at FROM notifications WHERE id = CAST(:id AS uuid)

db:select.doc:name: Read Status For Retry
db:select.db:sql: SELECT status FROM notifications WHERE id = CAST(:id AS uuid)

raise-error.description: Somente notificações com falha podem ser reenviadas.

db:update.doc:name: Reset To Pending
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE notifications SET status = 'PENDING', last_error_code = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE id = CAST(:id AS uuid)
